chars.YOUSRA: a young Moroccan woman, 20, long dark wavy hair, wearing a bright mustard-yellow satin party top and black wide-leg trousers, small gold hoop earrings
chars.IMANE: a young Moroccan woman, 20, short curly black hair in a puff, wearing an emerald-green sequin party dress with a denim jacket, white sneakers
chars.BEDGIRL: a young woman, 21, straight blonde-dyed hair in a high ponytail, wearing a pink oversized hoodie and grey sweatpants, always holding a smartphone
chars.HOST: a young Moroccan woman, 21, black hair in a sleek bun, wearing a red fitted party dress, a paper birthday crown on her head

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Marrakech apartment bedroom at night during a birthday party, YOUSRA and IMANE frantically search a messy room, opening a wardrobe and lifting cushions, worried faces

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Earlier that evening: YOUSRA and IMANE neatly placing their handbags and folded clothes together on a chair in the corner of a bedroom, smiling, party lights in the background

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: YOUSRA and IMANE standing beside a bed asking BEDGIRL, who lies on the bed under a blanket staring at her smartphone screen, ignoring them

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: YOUSRA on her knees looking under a bed with her phone flashlight while IMANE throws her hands up in frustration, angry expressions, dim bedroom

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of BEDGIRL lying on the bed, face lit by her smartphone glow, pretending not to hear, eyes sliding nervously to the side

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a crowded living room with balloons and colorful lights, YOUSRA and IMANE complaining to HOST, who looks surprised holding a drink cup

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: YOUSRA and IMANE back in the bedroom pulling clothes off chairs and checking behind curtains, determined and annoyed, night window with Marrakech city lights

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: YOUSRA leaning toward the bed, hand on her chest, politely but suspiciously asking BEDGIRL, who stays on the bed clutching her phone

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: BEDGIRL sitting stiffly on the bed, sweating and stammering, eyes wide, gripping the blanket tightly around her, tense dramatic lighting
